subject: Assembly cadence for contracting artifacts & evaluation cutover
messages:
From: Samir Patel <samir.patel@medsquad.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
Cc: Jill Turner <jill.turner@medsquad.com>, legal@medsquad.com
Date: Mon, 14 Jul 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Contracting kickoff + MAP ask

Hi Stephanie — thanks again for the demo last week. Procurement and legal asked me to pull a short mutual action plan so we can align dates for the MSA, DPA and the order form. High level asks from our side:

- Can Redwood provide a redline-ready MSA and a DPA template by next Tuesday (7/22)?
- We need a simple order form (line items + pricing) that legal can reference when signing.
- Can you confirm SOC2 evidence and retention terms (we've attached a SOC2 summary).

Our internal timeline is tight — procurement hopes to close commercial terms the week of 7/28 and legal wants the final signed docs in the first week of August so the pilot can start 8/4. If those dates are unrealistic, please propose alternatives and an MAP with checkpoints.

Attaching: MediSquad_SOC2_summary.pdf

Thanks,
Samir Patel
Head of Procurement, MediSquad Health
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
To: Samir Patel <samir.patel@medsquad.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 14 Jul 2025 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Contracting kickoff + MAP ask

Samir — appreciate the clear asks and the SOC2 summary. I sketched a short MAP below that balances your target dates with our internal legal/ops handoffs. Please review and flag any hard constraints.

Mutual Action Plan (proposed)
1) 7/14–7/18: Redwood sends draft MSA (redline-ready) + DPA template + preliminary order form (pricing sketch). Responsible: Redwood legal (Jordan) + AE (me).
2) 7/18–7/22: MediSquad reviews redlines; procurement returns commercial comments; legal returns DPA and data-retention questions. Checkpoint call: 7/22 10:00am PT.
3) 7/23–7/25: Jordan consolidates redlines and generates consolidated redline MSA; Redwood provides answers on SOC2 retention and access logs.
4) 7/26: Final commercial alignment (pricing/order form locked).
5) 7/28–8/01: Signature week (DocuSign routing); pilot enablement target 8/04.

Dependencies / gating items:
- If MediSquad redlines the MSA with >10 clause-level changes, legal will request an additional technical review window (adds 3 business days).
- Data residency/retention exceptions will require a DPA addendum — that will move signature out by ~1 week unless scoped now.

Attachments we'll send today: RDW-draft-MSA-v1.3.docx, orderform-lineitems-v2.xlsx

Next steps: Jordan (cc'd) will drop the draft MSA to you by EOD today. Can you confirm the 7/22 checkpoint call?

- Stephanie
Stephanie Nguyen
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
To: Samir Patel <samir.patel@medsquad.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 14 Jul 2025 14:27:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Contracting kickoff + MAP ask

Samir / Stephanie — adding a bit of legal sequencing detail so procurement can see where the real blockers typically appear. Quick notes:

1) MSA redline cadence: I will upload a consolidated redline on 7/18 after I triage comments. If MediSquad legal sends clause-level substantive edits (esp. indemnity, data security, limitation of liability), expect a 48–72h internal review.
2) DPA questions: Please call out any data residency or subprocessors in your initial review — that prevents a second addendum cycle.
3) Order form: we can lock pricing now for the pilot line items; any material changes after 7/24 will require an amendment.
4) Signature flow: Recommend parallel routing (procurement + legal) but we will not execute DocuSign until the DPA and MSA versions are aligned (common source-of-truth).

If anything looks off in the MAP above, propose changes here. I'll attach a simple redline checklist for your counsel to use during review.

-- Jordan Blake
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference
(Attachment: legal-redline-checklist.txt)
From: Jill Turner <jill.turner@medsquad.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
Cc: Samir Patel <samir.patel@medsquad.com>, legal@medsquad.com
Date: Tue, 15 Jul 2025 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Contracting kickoff + MAP ask

Thanks Stephanie / Jordan — calendar invite accepted for 7/22 10:00am PT. A couple of clarifying items from procurement/legal after reviewing the SOC2 summary and your MAP: 

- MediSquad requires a 30-day data retention exception for logs used in debugging pilot integrations. Is that acceptable or do you need a different window?
- We prefer a single order form with line items and a one-year term for the pilot; please confirm cancellation windows and trial usage caps.
- On signature routing: our legal prefers sequential routing (legal sign first) — will that block the go/no-go for the pilot start date?

Attaching: our intake checklist and an initial set of redline comments (stated as a list, not a formal redline).

Jill Turner
Procurement Manager, MediSquad Health
(Attachment: mediSquad-intake-checklist.pdf)
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
To: Jill Turner <jill.turner@medsquad.com>, Samir Patel <samir.patel@medsquad.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 16 Jul 2025 15:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Contracting kickoff + MAP ask — confirmed cadence and exception plan

Jill / Samir — following our check-ins and Jordan's review, here's the final agreed MAP and go/no-go decision points. I staged the dates so you have explicit cutovers for acceptance of each artifact.

Final MAP (agreed)
- 7/16: Redwood uploaded RDW-draft-MSA-v1.3.docx, orderform-lineitems-v2.xlsx, and the legal-redline-checklist to the shared drive.
- 7/18 EOD: MediSquad returns commercial redlines and DPA comments. (If not received, Redwood will follow up and propose a 48h escalation window.)
- 7/21: Jordan to issue consolidated redline MSA ready for counsels' side-by-side review.
- 7/22 10:00am PT: Checkpoint call (final list of open issues and signature plan).
- 7/24: Pricing and order form locked; any new commercial terms after this date require an amendment.
- 7/28–8/01: DocuSign execution window.
- 8/04: Pilot enablement — contingent on executed MSA + DPA + order form.

Decisions on open items:
- Data retention exception: Redwood agrees to a 30-day debug-log retention for the pilot only; this will be captured in the DPA addendum and sunset after the pilot term.
- Signature routing: Redwood will accommodate sequential routing (legal first) but requests procurement assist with post-signature tasks so enablement isn't delayed (targets outlined above).

Attachments included in the thread: RDW-draft-MSA-v1.3.docx; orderform-lineitems-v2.xlsx; MediSquad_SOC2_summary.pdf; mediSquad-intake-checklist.pdf; legal-redline-checklist.txt

If this matches your expectation, I'll issue the DocuSign envelope on 7/28 and Jordan will prep the DPA addendum language for the 30-day retention exception.

Thanks — looking forward to a tight run.

- Stephanie
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
